{{Quote|Some of us are meant to toil anonymously, furthering the cause. Some of us are spies. Some of us are dancers. And some are princesses. But we all want the same thing. I could see it in her eyes. She would die before she gave me up to the Imperials.|Sarin's thoughts on Leia Organa|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />}}
'''Sarin''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
===Agent uncovered===
{{Quote|Paranoid? Sure. In my line of work, you're either paranoid &mdash; or you're dead.|Sarin's thoughts|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />}}
[[File:Sarin_dancer.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sarin worked undercover as a dancer on Feddasyr.]]
Sarin was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, alongside their [[Sarin's sister|sister]], was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Twi'lek operated as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for five [[Local year|years]]<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" /> prior to the [[Time/Legends|time]] frame of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Heist]]'' is set between {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, as the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] steal the [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] seen in Episode V. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the films respectively to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> on [[Feddasyr]], a pleasure [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the site of a covert war between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Alliance. Because of their [[Color/Legends|red]] skin, a sought-after trait that was the product of being born a one-in-a-million [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] Twi'lek, Sarin had access to the highest-ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]].<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" /> One [[Local day/Legends|day]] during that time frame, they had to deliver an Imperial top-level security code to a rebel agent who, unbeknownst to them, was [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. By that time, Sarin had started to suspect their role was uncovered, noticing suspected agents watching them.<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />

On that day, Sarin was working as a dancer in a Feddasyr establishment in a settlement on the planet. When they left the place, the Twi'lek was tailed by an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Sarin)|Imperial officer]]. Sarin walked through an alleyway before they hid in a building and closed the door behind them. The Rebel spy changed their [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] just before the officer opened the door, though Sarin was able to kill the Imperial with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot to the chest. They then escaped the scene, running through the Feddasyr settlement. They hopped on boats going through canals of water, kissed an Imperial officer along the way, and eventually got to a [[Unidentified cantina (Feddasyr)|cantina]] to meet Organa.<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />

At the cantina, Sarin noticed an enemy [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] agent who was on to them but still went up to their contact. They told Organa that they were not able to get the code, and that their cover was blown. Sarin continued that they hoped the Alliance would send someone to help them with the Cerean before Organa revealed herself and told them to relax and trust her. Sarin was disappointed that the Alliance sent Organa, who the Twi'lek saw as not as cold-blooded or experienced as them. The two then walked out of the cantina while the Cerean began to [[Death/Legends|die]] from an untraceable poison placed in his drink by the Alliance-payed [[Unidentified bartender (Feddasyr)|bartender]].<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" /> 

===Tardee party===
{{Quote|Funny how I operate here for five years and the day you show up, my cover is blown.''"<br/>"''Yes. Unfortunate timing.|Sarin and Leia Organa|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />}}
That night, Leia infiltrated Jock Tardee's party under the alias of Nahob Skuts. While trying to find the imperial codes taken by Jock Tardee, an imperial [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] agent, sent for the codes as well, realized that Nahob Skuts was Leia Organa. However, before the Trandoshan could blow the princess's cover, he was killed by Sarin, using the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] left by Leia on the penthouse's balcony. After retrieving a [[Unidentified Stormtrooper (DNA codes)|stormtrooper defector]], which had the imperial codes encoded in his [[DNA/Legends|DNA]], Leia managed to escape the party and meet with Sarin, handing over the stormtrooper in her care before being captured by an imperial patrol. Sarin managed to evade the patrol and meet with their sister. They told their sister that the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] was "of critical importance to the cause" and had to be taken to the next [[Chewbacca/Legends|rebel contact]] on a [[Unidentified planet (reptilian species)|backwater planet]].

==Equipment==
{{Quote|The weapon she supplied is equipped with long-range surveillance gear. I'll be able to hear and see everything. And send a shot her way if she needs the help.|Sarin's thoughts on the sniper rifle Leia Organa supplied her|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />}}
While working as a dancer, Sarin wore a white top, white shorts, an armband, a brown headband, and a gold necklace. When they left the place they danced at, the Twi'lek put on a blue coat and blue heels. Sarin eventually changed into a black shirt, a gray jacket, black pants, and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] that night. The Rebel spy used an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] to defend themself against an Imperial officer and later used a sniper rifle with long range surveillance gear to guard Leia Organa at Jock Tardee's party.<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It would be cool to have four core characters, and each issue would play with that idea &mdash; Princess Leia and a spy character who she teams up with, but it's all from the point of view of the character Princess Leia teams up with.|Mark Kindt mentions Sarin in an interview with CBR|<ref name="CBR" />}}
Sarin was created for ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Heist]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries written by [[Matt Kindt]]. The character was indirectly mentioned in [[2013]] by Kindt in an exclusive interview with [[Wikipedia:Comic Book Resources|CBR]],<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/exclusive-kindt-plans-a-star-wars-rebel-heist-for-dark-horse|text=EXCLUSIVE: Kindt Plans A "Star Wars: Rebel Heist" for Dark Horse|author=Ching, Albert|date=2013-12-27|work=Comic Book Resources|archivedate=20200627022153}}</ref> before the characters first appearance in the [[Rebel Heist 2|second issue]] of ''Rebel Heist''. The issue was illustrated by [[Marco Castiello]]<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 28]], [[2014]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54475/star_wars_rebel_heist_2014_2|text=Star Wars: Rebel Heist (2014) #2}}</ref>
